summary.text: Sheryl Delozier is a Republican who represents Pennsylvania House District 88, which covers part of Cumberland County, and serves on the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to her official legislative biography, Delozier graduated from West Chester East High School in 1985, earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Delaware, and received a master's degree in management (business administration) from Pennsylvania State University.
